purpose: automatically unwrap UV-less surface geometry into deterministic padded connected charts and bake verified UC material maps into a native offline atlas
limitations: Offline bounded connected-chart fallback only; no global seam optimization, density-optimal packing, UDIMs, high-to-low cage baking, AO/curvature/thickness synthesis or MikkTSpace parity.
Separate chart cells are non-overlapping by construction, but projected triangles inside one shared chart are not yet overlap/distortion-tested.
Generated chart grouping and pixel gutters are technical evidence, not aesthetic acceptance.
Sources and failed product drafts remain preserved; existing outputs are refused.
